name: signal_demod
setup: fs = 200; t = (0:1/fs:0.1)'; x = sin(2*pi*5*t); y = modulate(x, 25, fs, 'am'); y_tc = modulate(x, 25, fs, 'amdsb-tc', 0.3);
expr: xd = demod(y, 25, fs, 'am'); n_xd = numel(xd); xd_5 = xd(5); xd_10 = xd(10); xd_15 = xd(15); err = max(abs(xd - 0.5*x)); xd_tc = demod(y_tc, 25, fs, 'amdsb-tc', 0.5); xdtc_5 = xd_tc(5); xdtc_10 = xd_tc(10); err_tc = max(abs(xd_tc + 0.2 - 0.5*x));
comment: MATLAB Signal Toolbox demod (Phase 4.13) — analog demodulation. Implements am / amdsb-sc (alias) / amdsb-tc; uses 5th-order Butterworth lowpass + filtfilt per MATLAB demod.m. Approximate-equal MATLAB R2025b on 8 fingerprints (tol 0.01); ~2e-3 diff vs MATLAB attributed to filtfilt initial-condition edge handling. KNOWN GAPs: fm/pm modes use hilbert (blocked on libs/signal::fft sign-convention bug — same blocker as Cycle J/LHS/SRH); amssb/pwm/ptm/ppm/qam similarly deferred. Octave 11.1.0 doesn't ship demod in core (signal package only).
